observed_result.historical_primitives: WebGPU float32 sparse drive and local derivatives execute on Apple M3 Metal without silent CPU fallback. 130 nodes/910 edges match independent float32 CPU results with max absolute difference 0; stress 20/100 repetitions and race passed. NewGPUTrainer Step, StepFrom, AdamW moments and new-process JSON snapshot continuation match CPU or uninterrupted GPU paths in 4-node fixture with no GPU skips; see sparse-backward-20260925/verification.json and gpu-trainer-20260925/verification.json.

assumption_statement: Insyra v0.3.4 remains the declared encoder/readout dependency. Its device execution was not probed. Device AdamW parameters/moments/counts are resident; neural state, activations and sparse weight transfers remain host managed. Timing is host wall-clock and buffer bytes are logical allocations.
limitations: Actual device training is the declared scalar zero-delay float32 profile on Apple M3 Metal. Neural state, activations and sparse weight transfers remain on the host; Insyra encoder/readout device execution is not probed.
GPU full-graph capacity, speedup, allocator VRAM and Linux/Windows GPU execution remain unverified.
The host phase times are single observations, not GPU timestamp-query or CPU-versus-GPU speedup measurements.

The original source-row WGSL weight gradient output sometimes left slots unwritten on Metal; separate per-edge writes and sentinel regression now pass, but the underlying compiler/driver layer was not identified.
Ubuntu 1 and Windows GPU execution are not verified.
Insyra sparse recurrent device API gap is tracked at https://github.com/HazelnutParadise/insyra/issues/379.
